methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper contains a methodology for the implementation of energy management system according to which companies can design there structure and processes to fulfil all the requirements specified in ISO 50001

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents the Totally Integrated Energy Management (TIEM) organisational/change-management framework, built on McKinsey's 7S model, for implementing an ISO 50001 energy management system. Energy indicators/key figures are mentioned only incidentally; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Falls under the eligibility rule excluding a framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: McKinsey's 7S change management tool provides the framework

stage1.notes: Conceptual 7S-based framework (TIEM) for EnMS implementation; no measurement model. Application context is German manufacturing/lean production (discrete), not a continuous-process sector; level_3b forced false by ineligibility.
